## About Vylex Web
Vylex Web builds high-performance, hand-coded custom websites, web applications, e-commerce stores, and business automation platforms for South African businesses. We do not use WordPress, heavy page builders, or generic templates. Everything is custom-engineered using modern web standards (HTML5, modern CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and Cloudflare CDN) for sub-second page loads, 100/100 Core Web Vitals, enterprise security, and native search engine rankings.

## Key Services
- **Custom Business Websites**: Fast, mobile-responsive, multi-page company websites with semantic SEO, structured schema data, and conversion funnels.
- **E-Commerce & Digital Catalogs**: High-speed online stores integrated with South African payment gateways (PayFast, Yoco, Ozow) and instant WhatsApp ordering.
- **Custom Web Applications & Portals**: Client portals, admin dashboards, booking engines, and bespoke business tools.
- **WordPress-to-Custom-Code Migrations**: Rebuilding slow, bloated WordPress/Elementor/Wix sites into lightning-fast, secure hand-coded platforms.
- **Technical SEO & AI Search Readiness**: Semantic HTML5, JSON-LD Schema.org markup, Core Web Vitals optimization, and Google Business Profile local search integration.

## Pricing Guide (ZAR)
- **Starter Web Presence**: From R2,500 (Ideal for single-page sites, landing pages, and small businesses needing fast Google discovery).
- **Business Growth Website**: From R5,000 (Multi-page custom architecture, local SEO schema, contact funnels, 100/100 performance).
- **E-Commerce / Custom App**: From R12,000 (Product catalog, checkout integrations, user authentication, bespoke database solutions).

## Tech Stack & Architecture
- Frontend: HTML5, Modern Vanilla CSS / Tailwind, JavaScript ES6+, React, Next.js
- Backend & APIs: Node.js, Express, REST/GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase
- Payments & Local Integrations: PayFast, Yoco, Ozow, WhatsApp Business API
- Hosting & Infrastructure: Cloudflare Edge Network, Vercel, AWS
